run_allocate_instances: run the script to launch N ECS Fargate instances and register CloudFlare subdomains for each
launch_instance: launch a single ECS Fargate task with a diverse or flat world config
request_instance: request multiple ECS instances and wait until all are up and reachable
is_instance_up: check if an ECS task instance is up by pinging its Minecraft port
register_dashboard_subdomain: register a CloudFlare DNS A record to proxy a dashboard subdomain to an instance IP
